module.name: Gateway
module.changelog: *17.0.17* Fix the Submit/Cancel action bar buttons disappearing when redisplaying the Add/Edit form after a failed validation (e.g. duplicate DID/IP/Account Code, cf 17.0.15). The form posts back to a plain URL with no "action" parameter, which getActionBar() relied on to decide whether to show the buttons; it now also checks the outcome of the just-processed add/edit attempt so the buttons stay visible while the user corrects the form. *17.0.16* Add a GraphQL API (allGateways, gateway, addGateway, updateGateway, removeGateway under the read:gateway/write:gateway scopes). Refactor add/update/delete into shared Gateway::addGateway()/updateGateway()/deleteGateway() so the web UI and the API run through the exact same validation, duplicate-checks and prepared-statement writes. *17.0.15* Prevent duplicate Gateway IP/Account Code/DID across gateways, with toast alerts. Harden field validation (strict formats, XSS/injection fixes, email validation bypass). Keep the Add/Edit form open with entered data on validation error instead of redirecting to the list. Add missing i18n translations. *17.0.14* Set user_eq_phone=yes on gateways for PSTN interop. Backfill PJSIP settings on existing gateways at install/upgrade. *17.0.13* Fixe some issues. *17.0.12* Add accountcode for local calls. *17.0.12* Add accountcode tags for inbound calls. Add call_limit for gateways. Shows status of gateways in the table. *17.0.11* New version. *17.0.10* Update and removing some stuffs. *17.0.9* Ready for GPL3. *17.0.8* Fixe issue showing wrong data when we are adding a gateway. *17.0.7* Fixe issue clearing json locales. *17.0.6* enable repos. *17.0.5* Translate JS i18n words. Fixe some bugs. *17.0.4* improving dialplan and fixe some regex bugs. *17.0.3* change dialplan. *17.0.2* fix some bugs. *17.0.1* Initial release.
module.description: Allow any extensions to be used as a gateway connected via a SIP trunk to another FreePBX server or Gateway.
